definitions.explanation: A person who comes from somewhere else and does not belong to a village, town or group. Often carries a sense of being kept at a distance; also used of oneself (よそ{者|もの}{扱|あつか}いされる, to be treated as an outsider).

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧よそ{者|もの}だ。
⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧よそ{者|もの}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{冷|つめ}たかった→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧。
examples.english: The villagers were cold to outsiders.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}して→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧きて{十年|じゅうねん}たって⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧よそ{者|もの}⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ことがある→ことがある：32886_kotogaaru⟧。
examples.english: Even ten years after moving here, I'm sometimes still treated as an outsider.

notes:
Also written {余所者|よそもの}. From よそ (somewhere else, other people's).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- よそ{者|もの}⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧: being treated as an outsider
- よそ{者|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{嫌|きら}う→嫌う：02048_kirau⟧: to be wary of outsiders
- よそ{者|もの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: an outsider's perspective (often positive in town revitalization talk)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{部外者|ぶがいしゃ}→部外者：15595_bugaisha⟧: an outsider to an organization or matter — formal, neutral
- ⟦{見知|みし}らぬ{人|ひと}→見知らぬ人：26016_mishiranuhito⟧: a stranger, someone one has never met
